description: This file defines the 'Independent' class in the torch.distributions module, which reinterprets batch dimensions as event dimensions for probability distributions, including methods for sampling, computing log probabilities, and properties related to distribution support.

classes.name: Independent
classes.description: A distribution class that reinterprets some batch dims as event dims, allowing for flexible distribution shape manipulations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes an Independent distribution with a base distribution and number of batch dims to reinterpret as event dims.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Returns a new Independent distribution expanded to a specified batch shape.

methods.name: has_rsample
methods.description: Property indicating if the base distribution supports reparameterized sampling.

methods.name: has_enumerate_support
methods.description: Property indicating if the distribution supports enumeration over its support.

methods.name: support
methods.description: Property that returns the support constraints of the distribution, adjusted for reinterpreted dims.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the base distribution.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the base distribution.

methods.name: variance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the base distribution.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a sample from the base distribution with an optional sample shape.

methods.name: rsample
methods.description: Generates a reparameterized sample from the base distribution.

methods.name: log_prob
methods.description: Computes the log probability of a value, summing over the reinterpreted batch dims.

methods.name: entropy
methods.description: Calculates the entropy of the distribution, summing over reinterpreted dims.

methods.name: enumerate_support
methods.description: Returns the support enumeration if reinterpreted dims are zero; otherwise raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Independent distribution.
